chip_id_register.value: none printed; no WHO_AM_I/chip-ID register (command-only interface)

identity_read.value: command 0x89 returns 2x16-bit words + CRC-8 = unique per-device serial number (OTP, assigned in production). No fixed identity value printed; serial differs per unit, so cannot be compared to a datasheet constant. CRC-8 poly 0x31 init 0xFF is checkable.

supply_voltage.value: 1.08 min / 3.3 typ / 3.6 max V; no separate I/O range (VIL 0.3*VDD, VIH 0.7*VDD)

package.value: DFN, 4 pins (SDA,SCL,VDD,VSS), open cavity; body 1.5 x 1.5 x 0.5 mm per Sensirion product page (WebFetch 2026-11-19), datasheet dims only in drawing Fig 15 p15 (not extracted); pitch not printed in text. Central die pad not to be soldered (p16). Definitely NOT LGA-8 2.5x2.5 P0.65 compatible (4 pins vs 8).

operating_temp.value: -40 to 125 C (specified range -40..+125 C); RH 0-100 %RH; best performance 5-60 C / 20-80 %RH

powerup_time.value: 0.3 typ / 1 max ms (VDD>=VPOR to idle; measured at -40C, 1.08V)

soft_reset_time.value: 1 max ms (after ACK of reset cmd 0x94; also valid for I2C general call reset 0x06 to addr 0x00)

pin_capacitance.value: pin/input capacitance not printed; bus load limit Cb 400 pF (fast mode, Rp<=820 ohm), 340 pF (FM+, Rp=390 ohm)

supply_current.value: idle 0.08 typ uA at 25C (1.0 at ~ 25C? table: 0.08 / 1.0 / 3.4 uA listed as 'At 25 C / At 125 C' - column alignment ambiguous in extraction, recheck figure); measurement 320 typ / 500 max uA; power-up 50 typ uA; avg @1 meas/s: 2.2 (high rep.) / 1.2 (med) / 0.4 (low) uA typ

heater.value: Integrated heater, 3 powers 20/110/200 mW (typ, VDD=3.3V), 0.1 s or 1 s pulses, commands 0x15/0x1E/0x24/0x2F/0x32/0x39; max duty 10%; heater-on idle current 6/33/60 mA typ, 10/55/100 mA max. Off by default: each heater command self-terminates after 1 s max, there is no heater-on state to persist; 'no dedicated command to turn off' (Table 9: 0 = off). Datasheet does not literally say 'off at power-up'.
